title: Big Card Solitaire
tagline: Huge cards, tap to play, every deal winnable.
description: Big Card Solitaire is Klondike redrawn for comfort: oversized high-contrast cards, tap-to-move instead of dragging, and no timers or flashing effects. Every deal is checked so it can actually be won. A built-in "what can I do?" hint highlights your legal moves whenever you're unsure.

title: Crown Fields
tagline: One crown per row, column and region. No touching.
description: Crown Fields is a calm grid-placement puzzle: place one crown in every row, column and coloured region so that no two crowns touch, even diagonally. Every puzzle is generated fresh with exactly one solution. Play a quick 7x7 for a coffee break, or unlock the tougher 10x10 Expert board. No timers, no pressure - just clean logic.

title: Sure Sweep
tagline: No-guess minesweeper. Every board solves by logic alone.
description: Sure Sweep is classic mine-clearing with one guarantee: every board can be fully solved by logic, with no lucky guesses required. Tap to reveal, flag suspected mines, and chord through satisfied numbers to clear the board fast. Stuck? A hint shows you the deduction you missed.
